The numeral counts sexual misconduct, coveting and stealing; it is the initial English three after Another, not a count of the poisons.
The completing root of these three acts is desire. The complete HGM record supports desire; no repeated sexual-desire member is inferred from the first compound.
Whole agentive kyis is the first English by before desire; no attached s is split.

The completion root is nominally recast as completion in the first resultative-causative clause. HGM rdzogs has finishing/finish; the phrase rdzogs par byed has no HGM gloss and is not treated as an independent lexical attestation.

Resultative par introduces the achieved state in rdzogs par byed; the first English to links brought to completion. This grammatical mapping is grounded in this clause, not a missing standalone par dictionary entry.
First causative byed is the first brought; the complete HGM byed record includes brought. Passive are remains outside this lexical atom.
Full established technical wrong-view compound owns sentence-initial Mistaken views, with exact capitalization and glossary support.
Strictly tighter first parent member: log par has HGM mistaken. This is inside the first wrong-view compound, not the initial sexual-misconduct compound.
The curated lta ba view and glossary views support the unique views member inside this parent. The curated correct-view qualification is a separate context, not a contradiction or replacement here.
The completing root of mistaken views is ignorance. The HTG2016 record says ignorance/ignorant, not ignorance of things; an and of things remain supplied wording outside the atom.
Whole gis owns the second by, before an ignorance of things; it cannot take the earlier desire-clause by.
Second completion is the state of the mistaken views, not the first trio; retain the distinct source and English occurrence.
Second resultative par owns the to in the mistaken-view completion clause, distinct from the first to.
Second causative byed owns the second brought, in the mistaken-view clause; no passive auxiliary is assigned.

Keep this complete intensity-plus-ignorance phrase at d3. rmongs pa explicitly has lack of understanding; cher has intense degree/on a gross level, not an exact deep-seated gloss. The complete local clause and its C16 duplicate support the phrase recast, while an independent cher/deep-seated dictionary atom would overstate evidence.

Ablative las names the source of mistaken views, rendered from before the deep-seated lack. Curated las/deeds is the noun sense, while the separate glossary from and local syntax support this particle.
The reduced wrong-view compound is repeated in the reason clause, with lowercase mistaken views. This is a second source term, not reuse of the earlier parent.
The unique tighter log member has exact HGM mistaken and modifies views inside this second technical parent. No unsupported view stem child is added.
The complete verb form has exact HTG2016 spring. It asserts the arising of mistaken views from ignorance, not completion of the acts; bound genitive i remains outside.
Final causal phyir introduces the explanatory reason rendered for. It scopes the entire mistaken-views-spring clause; the prior de is not separately assigned the same English connective.
